result:
QA-29278 on Apple Services / Apple Music (TikTok only, Impressions data set, Oct 20–26) is a **FAIL**: A1 fails and A2 passes.

- **A1 (Total Impressions shows a value on every post):** 19 of 22 posts show a number. The posts ranked 18, 19 and 20 show "–". All three are the same Apple Music TikTok video, posted Oct 25 at 10:37 PM PDT. A fourth post with the same text and timestamp shows 3, so the "–" is a missing value. The grid view shows the same dashes as the table.
- **A2 (Organic and Paid Impressions are en-dash):** all 22 posts show "–" for both, and so does the Sum row.

No linked bugs apply, so I did not attribute the failure to a known bug. It matches the earlier HBO Max failure on 10-26, which `known-quirks.md` ties to the brand's TikTok feed. I did not run the other Wednesday pairs (NBCU Enterprises with CNBC and NBC News), so I can't say whether the gap is specific to Apple Music. I did no skill or registry maintenance and filed no Jira ticket, per the run instructions.

The report is at `results/2026-10-28/QA-29278-report.md`, with screenshots in `.playwright-out/QA-29278/`.
